 assert ref(first['parent']['path'])==first['parent'] and ref(new['parent']['path'])==new['parent']

 def fingerprint(value):

 assert fingerprint(original_base)==first['parent_values']==validation_rows[step]['original_values']
 assert not np.array_equal(base.view(np.uint32),original_base.view(np.uint32))
